_doc: Durable per-(worker, task-type) success tally driving break-even routing. Orchestrator reads at session start to seed p, keeps the running tally in-context during the session, and at the Deliver step dispatches ONE cheap-coder-kimi edit to merge session deltas (only when an outcome materially changed). Schema and usage: .github/agents/pool-reference.md. task-type is a coarse, consistent label, e.g. code:styling, code:concurrency, reason:architecture, review:ui.
